title: Book Three · Chapter 15: The Loose Handle
story:
The fourth week starts with a broken pencil sharpener.

It stands on a shelf near the classroom door. Its handle turns, but it moves from side to side too.

Ronan holds the box steady. A girl tries to sharpen her pencil. The handle comes off in her hand.

She stares at it.

“It was loose before,” Ronan says.

“Now it is very loose.”

Kai comes over. He puts his own pencil on the shelf and looks at the handle.

“The screw is out,” he says.

He looks inside the box. Then he bends down.

“Don't move your feet.”

Ronan stays still. Kai picks up a tiny screw near his shoe.

The teacher comes through the door. The girl holds up the handle.

“It came off.”

“Put it on my desk,” the teacher says. “I will ask someone to look at it.”

“I can put the handle back,” Kai says. “We need a small screwdriver.”

The teacher looks at the parts. She takes a little tool from her desk drawer.

“You can try. Leave the rest of the sharpener closed.”

Kai carries the sharpener to her desk. Ronan and the girl follow.

Kai fits the handle into place. He turns it gently, then stops. The hole in the handle is not over the hole beneath it.

He lifts it off and tries again.

This time, the screw goes in. He turns the screwdriver slowly.

Ronan watches his fingers. Kai does not press hard. When the screw stops, he stops too.

“Hold the box,” he tells Ronan.

Ronan puts both hands on it. Kai turns the handle. It moves around smoothly.

Kai lets go of the handle. Ronan takes one hand off the box.

“Will it move again?” Ronan asks.

“Try it.”

Ronan turns the handle slowly. The whole box starts to slide across the desk. He stops and puts his other hand back.

Kai points to the bottom. “The handle is firm. You still need to hold the box.”

Ronan tries again. This time, the box stays still.

The girl puts her pencil into the opening. Kai turns the handle again. A little wood falls into the box.

She takes out the pencil. Its point is sharp.

“Thank you.”

Kai gives the screwdriver back to the teacher. Then he empties the sharpener over the bin.

Ronan carries it to the shelf.

“Did the car work too?” he asks.

“Yes. My cousin drove it under a chair.”

“Straight away?”

“Before I put the screwdriver down.”

The girl laughs. She goes back to her desk with her pencil.

Kai's friend calls from the window. He has a small packet of food. Kai goes over and takes half.

Ronan sharpens his own pencil. He holds the box steady without a second pair of hands.

At the bell, Kai comes back to his desk. There is a little wood on his sleeve.

Ronan points to it.

“You missed some.”

Kai brushes his sleeve. The wood falls onto his chair.

He looks down and sighs.

Ronan moves the bin a little closer.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sharpener＝卷笔刀；handle＝手柄；steady＝稳住的、平稳的；smoothly＝顺畅地。

## 理解问题

1. 卷笔刀哪里出了问题？Kai有没有拆开整台卷笔刀？
2. Ronan在修理时帮了什么忙？修好后怎样确认它能用？

## 读句子

**Ronan puts both hands on it.**

拆开看：Ronan / puts both hands / on it.

Ronan／把双手放上去／放在它上面（it指卷笔刀的盒体）。
